selection_scope: Jupiter YOLO plus at most five relevant projects; no count target.

candidates.name: Jupiter YOLO
candidates.rationale: Mandatory anchor; official identity and explicit-inspiration primary-source verification is owned by the YOLO profile.

candidates.name: Cardboard Trade
candidates.rationale: Official house/FIFO/loss-issued-staking-token documentation plus public product-specific activity API. Code-fork ancestry not established.

candidates.name: Trade Everything
candidates.rationale: Explicit official model attribution; useful equity-market extension. Corrects third-party Solana attribution. Mainnet aggregate paths returned 502; BTC/ETH routing conflicts with other Draft pages and cannot be independently aggregated.

candidates.name: Rektrade
candidates.rationale: Official embedded docs and public API support house/FIFO/loss-issued-token mechanism and operating activity; historical mint/price descriptions conflict with current API. Ember is a second frontend for the same venue.

candidates.name: STOX
candidates.rationale: Official frontend supports house, queue and loss-issued shares, with a direct house-deposit difference. Mirrored live-trading claims exist; contract/config binding and independent live-fill evidence remain needed before firm operational classification. Root agent owns full profile.

candidates.name: Parchment Trade
candidates.rationale: Only mirrored introduction/Pyth interaction acquired; no established official application domain, deployment or real-money trading. 1000x alone is insufficient.

exclusions.reason: Virtual-money simulation does not create the real-USDC house/liability mechanism.

examples: unverified PAPER tickers on other chains
exclusions.reason: Ticker/name alone does not establish a derivative product or affiliation.
Integrations or participation in an existing venue are not independent house LP competitors; track routing separately.
Discovery-list membership is not product/deployment/live-trading verification.

known_corrections: Trade Everything is documented on HyperEVM, despite the third-party list grouping it under Solana.
Ember and Rektrade share a venue according to mirrored official statements.
No evidence establishes code-fork ancestry merely from similar leverage.

search_boundary.method: Use discovery lists only as leads, then official-domain/account links, documentation, published frontend aggregate paths and bounded deployment/transaction checks.
stop_conditions: 403/401/429: stop that project; do not bypass.
No identity or live-product evidence: preserve unknowns and exclude from firm operating comparisons.
No reason to fill the six-project cap.
